title: 2026 Global AI Supply-Chain Chokepoints Dataset & Four Sovereignty Invariants Auditor
description: Structured 12-layer dataset of global AI compute supply-chain chokepoints (Spruce Pine quartz, ASML High-NA EUV lithography, TSMC CoWoS packaging, HBM4 memory, HVDC grid transformers, extraterritorial cloud jurisdiction) and Python/MCP sovereignty exposure auditor. Companion to 'The Sovereign Illusion: AI, Geopolitics, and Power in an Interdependent World' by Victor Brooks (Digbijoy Labs).
